top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the four children's records evaluated, one was behind with required immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. The operations backyard fence has multiples gaps measuring larger than 3.5 inches and less than 9 inches.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPR training for the director was completed online.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The immunization record for one child was not up to date.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was information received stating that children are on their phones throughout the day exceeding the limit of 1 hour of screen time.

top_violation_types.title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level (26 TAC §747.4015)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children, ages 4 months, 13 months and 2 years old, were being cared for on the second level of the child care home. Children can't be cared for on the second level of a home without written approval from the fire marshall.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.
